subject: FinTechCo deployment mode & security follow-up
summary: Post-discovery follow-up covering deployment mode options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem) with focus on SSO (Okta), customer KMS/HSM requirements, and long-term logging retention. Next steps: security deep-dive, SOC2 and KMS material, procurement timeline.
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechCo deployment mode & security follow-up

Hi Alex

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your security and procurement teams have a single reference:

Summary of needs you shared:
- SSO: Okta SAML + SCIM provisioning for user access
- Key management: customer-managed keys required; preference for HSM-backed keys for cryptographic operations
- Logging: retention requirement of 7 years for high-sensitivity logs (audit trail)
- Data residency: primary region US (we discussed multi-region replication later)

How those map to Redwood deployment options (short):
- Hosted API: fastest to ship but does NOT support customer HSMs. We can support Okta SSO for developer console access; customer-managed KMS in host cloud is limited and not HSM-backed. Logging retention is our default (90 days) with export options.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): supports VPC peering and customer-managed KMS in your cloud account (BYOK) — good for most KMS needs but not for customer HSM appliances inside your network. Extended logging retention add-on possible or forward logs to your SIEM for long-term retention.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): full support for customer KMS/HSM and longer on-prem logging retention, plus isolated control plane. This is the path if you need an HSM appliance under your control.

Attachments: FinTechCo_Security_Requirements.pdf (your doc) — I attached for internal referencing. Also attaching Redwood_Soc2_Report.pdf and Redwood_KMS_Integration_Guide.pdf for your engineers.

Proposed next steps:
1) Security deep-dive with our Solutions Engineer (Vivek) to validate HSM/PKI requirements and logging architecture — 60 min.
2) Share procurement timeline and any required redlines on the MSA.
3) If you prefer Dedicated as a first step, we can scope a proof-of-concept reservation and a KMS integration plan. If HSM is a hard requirement, Private is the recommended path.

Can you please confirm who from your compliance/infosec should join the deep-dive and a couple of times that work this week?

Thanks
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo deployment mode & security follow-up

Thanks Marissa, this is helpful. Couple clarifying points from our security team:

- HSM: We do require HSM-backed key material for the signing keys used for financial workflows. If Dedicated only supports cloud KMS without HSM, that might not be sufficient. Can you confirm whether Redwood Dedicated can integrate with AWS CloudHSM or a customer-managed HSM?
- Logging: 7-year retention is a hard requirement for audit logs. We typically forward logs to our own logging tier (Splunk/Datadog) for retention, would need guidance on log formats and export cadence.

We'd like to join the deep-dive. Proposed attendees from our side: me (Alex), Priya Natarajan (Head of Compliance), and our infra lead (TBD). Best times are Wed 6/23 10–12 PST or Thu 6/24 9–11 PST.

Also, can you send any SOC2 + architecture docs you have? That will speed the procurement conversation.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo deployment mode & security follow-up

Alex, great to meet you on the call yesterday (virtually). Quick notes from an engineering/security perspective:

- Dedicated: we can do BYOK where the key material is stored in your cloud KMS; however, CloudHSM integration (customer-managed HSM appliance) is not supported in the hosted Dedicated offering today. For workloads that require an HSM under customer control, the Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) is the recommended route.
- Workaround: for some customers we use CloudKMS with imported key material and strict IAM boundaries; depends on whether your compliance accepts cloud-HSM managed by the customer account.
- Logs: we can forward structured logs (JSON) continuously to your Splunk/Datadog endpoint or to an S3 bucket in your account for long-term retention. We also offer an extended-retention add-on but many customers prefer pushing to their own storage for a 7+ year retention SLA.

I can run the deep-dive and bring our infra architect to discuss KMS import vs HSM options and the log-forwarding pipeline. Proposed slots: Wed 6/23 10:30–11:30 PST or Thu 6/24 09:00–10:00 PST. Which works for your team?

Attaching Redwood_Soc2_Report.pdf and Redwood_KMS_Integration_Guide.pdf for your compliance and infra review.
